usagePrompt:
Multi-screen adds a dual-chart trading view to an Orderly DEX: two independent TradingPage panels side by side, each with its own symbol selector and localStorage-persisted symbol (so left/right selections survive a page reload). Layout stacks vertically below 1024px viewport width.

Install:
1. npm install @pacrypto55/multiscreen (peer deps: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, and @orderly.network/hooks, types, trading, ui-scaffold, plugin-core ^3.1.x).
2. Register the plugin so the "Multi-screen" entry auto-appears in your main nav, by passing registerMultiscreenPlugin() in the plugins array of your OrderlyAppProvider.
3. Mount the route yourself (no page-injection API exists in the SDK yet, so this step is manual): import MultiScreenLayout and MultiScreen from the package, plus its styles.css, and add a router entry for path "multiscreen" whose element is MultiScreenLayout wrapping an index route whose element is MultiScreen (pass your tradingViewConfig and sharePnLConfig as props).

Known limitation: hiding the order book / markets sidebar inside each panel relies on CSS targeting Orderly UI internal class names (documented in src/styles.css), since the SDK has no public prop for this yet. Re-verify those selectors if you are on an SDK version outside the pinned ^3.1.x range.
